generalInfo.generalRule: Every guest who visits Hard Rock Stadium deserves the best possible experience. You can contribute to a great experience by always conducting yourself appropriately and making sure anyone who uses your tickets does the same. For the enjoyment and safety of all, the following behaviors are prohibited in and around Hard Rock Stadium: • Behavior that is unruly, disruptive, or illegal in nature • Intoxication or other signs of alcohol or substance impairment that results in irresponsible behavior • Foul or abusive language or obscene gestures • Interference with the progress of the game (including throwing objects onto the field) • Failing to follow instructions of law enforcement, guest experience, and security personnel • Verbal or physical harassment of all fans, Hard Rock Stadium staff, officials, team personnel and players. Verbal or physical harassment of opposing team fans • Unreasonably obstructing the view of other patrons • Offensive language, obscene gestures, language or clothing, to include the use of such language, or gestures concerning a person's race, ethnicity, color, gender, religion, creed, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity/ expression or national origin; or to instigate, incite or encourage a confrontation or physical assault. • Any conduct deemed inappropriate or dangerous to fans, participants, officials or stadium staff • Smoking and the use of electronic cigarettes • Unauthorized advertising or other commercial activities • Failure to comply with stadium policies • Conduct that results in damage to Hard Rock Stadium or other personal property What is the bag policy? For the safety and security of all, guests are encouraged to not bring any type of bags, but fans will be able to carry the following style and size bag, package, or container at stadium plaza areas, stadium gates, or when approaching queue lines of fans awaiting entry into the stadium: Allowed: • Clear plastic bags that do not exceed 12" x 6" x 12" • Small bags or fanny packs that do not exceed 4.5" x 6.5" • Diaper bags are permitted, and subject to search • Factory-sealed, plastic bottles of water that are 20 oz. or less in size Prohibited: • All purses or bags that exceed 12" x 6" x 12" • Non-clear bags that exceed 4.5" x 6.5" What items are prohibited? The following items are not permitted to be carried into Hard Rock Stadium: • Aerosol cans (e.g., mace, pepper spray or sunscreen) • Alcohol of any kind • Any animal except for a service animal or service animal in training • Flagpoles • Cigarettes or electronic smoking devices • Computer or tablets are not permitted if they are larger than 12" x 2" x 12" • Fireworks, flares, explosives, ammunition, or other incendiary devices • Glass bottles, cans, coolers of any kind, thermoses, or ice chests • Purses or bags that exceed 12" X 6" X 12" • Seat cushions of any size except those for medical needs • Video cameras, monopods, tripods, audio recording devices, and professional cameras (those including telephoto or zoom lenses) • Selfie Sticks • Umbrellas, strollers, laser pointers • Weapons and any item that may be used as a projectile or one that is deemed dangerous by Hard Rock Stadium management • Any other item deemed inappropriate by Hard Rock Stadium management
generalInfo.childRule: All guests must have a ticket to enter Hard Rock Stadium, except that, for Miami Dolphins games, children that are under two and up to 34″ inches in height may enter Hard Rock Stadium free of charge but must share a seat with an accompanying ticketed adult. Occasionally, for other non-Miami Dolphins events, another policy may be in place.

Improv Acting 1 - Improv Scenework
events.info: Improv Acting 1 will meet for seven weeks -- every Thurday night from Nov. 5th at our theater located at 3119 Coral Way in Miami. The student performance will take place on the seventh Thursday night. The fourth class on Thanksgiving will take place the night before -- Wednesday night Nov. 25th. ***Register by November 1st receive a $25 discount off the regular $300 price! IMPROV ACTING 1 - Improv Scenework (meets one night a week, 7:30pm - 10:00pm) Just The Funny is Miami's leading, and most comprehensive, improv and sketch education resource. JTF's classes are professionally designed, fully structured, syllabus-driven courses taught by JTF's improv professionals, and all students receive a certificate of completion for each course! Just The Funny's Improv Acting Series classes and Sketch Writing class also include end of course student performances! 7-week introductory class focuses on improvisational acting. Learn the techniques to improvise scenes and characters for auditions, ad-libbing, or just to sharpen your acting skills, in Miami's most popular improv class! Improv Classes have also been known to benefit individuals in the following areas: Confidence Public Speaking For performers, complements their acting skillset Comfort in Social Settings Brainstorming Abilities Listening and Observation Decision-Making Team Development In addition, there are other classes in our multi-level program for those who wish to continue studying past Improv Acting 1. ***** Improv Acting 1 is part of JTF's BEGINNERS Study Track This class will take place at our theater at 3119 Coral Way. You may reach us directly to find out more by emailing us at: classes@justthefunny.com ***** SPACES ARE LIMITED! REGISTER TODAY! Note: All sales are final.
